_why: Landing-page settings that are not in wri-html-pages identity.json. A personal copy at ~/.config/external-facing-website/site.json (or $EFW_SITE_CONFIG) wins and survives updates. Logo files are looked up next to the copy in use first, then in this skill's assets/logos/. Never put a PIN here.
